model.title: Retire through Ownership Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Roger Marshall (R-KS)

summary.text: The bill would clarify how Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOPs) determine the fair market value of company stock that isn't publicly traded, by allowing plan fiduciaries to rely on valuations from independent experts who follow established appraisal methodologies. This aims to give workers and plan managers greater confidence in the value assigned to their retirement benefits in closely held companies.
